meta.title: How Well Do You Know Naomi?
meta.subtitle: The Official 40th Birthday Quiz
meta.welcomeMessage: Welcome! Test your knowledge against Naomi's closest friends to claim your spot in the Hall of Fame.

ecard.message: Gather round, friends! Before the cake is cut and the champagne flows, let's celebrate the birthday girl. Flip through the memories floating by... then test how well you really know Naomi.

scoreTiers.title: Casual Acquaintance 😬
scoreTiers.message: Are you sure you're at the right party? Time to buy Naomi a drink and catch up!

scoreTiers.title: Solid Mate 👍
scoreTiers.message: Not bad! You know Naomi pretty well, but a few core memories slipped past you.

scoreTiers.title: Ride or Die 💖
scoreTiers.message: Seriously impressive. You've clearly logged some quality Naomi hours over the years.

scoreTiers.title: Naomi's Inner Circle 👑
scoreTiers.message: Legendary score! You either have a vault of Naomi memories or you helped write these questions.

questions.question: What was Naomi's very first job back in high school?
questions.funFact: She lasted 3 weeks before getting banned from eating the cookie dough!

questions.question: Where was this photo of Naomi taken during her 2018 trip?
questions.funFact: Taken 30 seconds before she dropped her sunglasses off the chairlift.

questions.question: What is Naomi's go-to karaoke song?
questions.funFact: She insists on the full key change and refuses to share the mic.

questions.question: Which pet did Naomi adopt first?
questions.funFact: Biscuit is now 12 and still steals socks from every houseguest.

questions.question: What was the theme of Naomi's legendary 30th birthday party?
questions.funFact: The disco ball is still hanging in her garage to this day.

questions.question: What food will Naomi absolutely NOT eat, no matter what?
questions.funFact: She once returned a pizza because a single olive touched a slice.

questions.question: In which city did Naomi live when she first moved out of home?
questions.funFact: She swears the Melbourne coffee ruined her for everywhere else.

questions.question: What hobby did Naomi unexpectedly pick up during 2020?
questions.funFact: Her starter is named 'Gary' and has his own spot in the fridge.
